name: Your Auto Shop
facts: The app is for an auto repair shop: build a quote, book a time, and track your car's repair from your phone.
Hours shown in the app: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 9am-3pm, closed Sunday.
The shop's exact address is sent after your booking is confirmed.
Phone/text number shown in the app: (555) 010-0000.
Prices in the app are samples. The final quote comes after inspection.
Arrival windows are 2 hours long, and you can book up to 7 days ahead.
The app works in English and Spanish.
My Garage is saved on your phone only, with no account.
The check-engine scanner is read-only and never clears codes.
The Pay with QR screen is a demo, and no real payment is processed.
Alerts (in-app, text, email) are simulated in the demo.
Tire size checker shows sample stock and sample brands.
The shop has no points, rewards or games in this app.
suggested: How do I get a price quote?
How do I book a time?
Do you have my tire size in stock?
How do I track my car?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: The app shows Monday to Friday 8am-6pm, Saturday 9am-3pm, and closed Sunday. The top of the app also shows if the shop is open right now.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: The hours in the app show Sunday as closed.

qa.q: Are you open on Saturday?
qa.a: Yes, the app shows Saturday 9am-3pm.

qa.q: Are you open right now?
qa.a: Check the bar at the top of the app. It says "Open now" with the closing time, or when the shop opens next.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Monday to Friday the shop closes at 6pm, and Saturday at 3pm, per the hours in the app.

qa.q: Do you have holiday hours?
qa.a: I don't have holiday hours. Please call or text the number shown in the app, (555) 010-0000, to ask.

qa.q: What's your address?
qa.a: For privacy, the exact address is sent to you after your booking is confirmed. The app shows only the general area.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: The app shows only the area. You get the exact address once your booking is confirmed.

qa.q: Where do I park?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Ask staff or call the number shown in the app, (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: The app shows (555) 010-0000. You can tap Call / text on the home screen.

qa.q: Can I text the shop?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the Call / text button on the home screen to send a text message to the shop.

qa.q: What's your email?
qa.a: I don't have an email to share. Please call or text the number shown in the app, (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: Do I need to create an account?
qa.a: No. There's no sign-up in the app. Your garage and requests are saved on your phone.

qa.q: How do I sign up or join?
qa.a: You don't need to. Just open the app, pick your car and start a quote.

qa.q: Do you have a rewards or points program?
qa.a: I don't see a points or rewards program in this app. Ask staff if the shop has any deals.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: This app doesn't have points. Ask staff or call (555) 010-0000 about any loyalty offers.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club or birthday deal?
qa.a: I don't have any birthday offer in the app. Ask staff to be sure.

qa.q: Do you have a referral program?
qa.a: I don't have a referral program listed. Ask staff or call (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: Are there games or contests?
qa.a: No. This app has no games, contests or weekly leaderboard.

qa.q: Do you have specials or happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any specials listed in the app. Ask staff or call (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: No, the app has no levels or tiers.

qa.q: What does the app do?
qa.a: You pick your car, say what's wrong, see a price range, book a time and track the repair from your phone.

qa.q: How do I get a price quote?
qa.a: Pick your car, then type what's wrong or tap the spot on the car. Tap Find the fix + price and the app builds your quote.

qa.q: Are the prices final?
qa.a: No. Prices in the app are samples, and the final quote comes after the shop inspects your car.

qa.q: What does "Ask for a quote" mean?
qa.a: For some services the shop sets the price after looking at your car, so the app doesn't show a number.

qa.q: What's your labor rate?
qa.a: The app uses $95 per hour for labor in its sample estimates.

qa.q: Is there a trip fee?
qa.a: The trip fee in the app is $0. For mobile service, the config lists free trips within 15 miles. Confirm with staff.

qa.q: How do I tell you what's wrong with my car?
qa.a: Type it in your own words, like "squeaks when I brake", or tap a glowing spot on the car picture.

qa.q: What does Step 1 "Your car" ask for?
qa.a: Year, make and model, or a 17-character VIN. Engine, drivetrain, trim, mileage and paint color are optional.

qa.q: How do I add my car by VIN?
qa.a: Type your 17-character VIN and tap Decode. It fills in your car's details.

qa.q: Where do I find my VIN?
qa.a: I don't have VIN location tips. The door jamb sticker on the driver's side is a common spot, and staff can help.

qa.q: Where is my paint code?
qa.a: It's on the sticker in the driver's door jamb. Look for PAINT, C/TR or EXT.

qa.q: Can I upload a photo of my car?
qa.a: Yes, you can take or upload a photo of your car. It's saved on your phone only.

qa.q: Can the app identify my car from a photo?
qa.a: Not yet. That feature is marked as coming soon.

qa.q: Is there a 3D model of my car?
qa.a: A 3D model from a photo is shown as a premium add-on that's coming soon.

qa.q: What services do you offer?
qa.a: Diagnostics, mobile call-outs, inspections, oil changes, brakes, tires, lights, battery, engine and tune-ups, transmission, suspension, steering, electrical, A/C and heating, wipers, glass, doors and windows, exhaust, and more. Tap Services in the app to see the full list.

qa.q: How do I add a service to my job?
qa.a: Tap any service in the Services list, choose an option, and it's added to your job and quote.

qa.q: Do you do oil changes?
qa.a: Yes: conventional, full synthetic, synthetic blend, high-mileage and diesel oil changes. Sample prices run about $80-95 for conventional and $105-155 for full synthetic. The final quote comes after inspection.

qa.q: Do you do brakes?
qa.a: Yes: brake pads, pads plus rotors, and brake fluid flush. Sample prices are about $145-265 per axle for pads and $295-490 per axle for pads plus rotors.

qa.q: Do you fix tires?
qa.a: Yes: rotation, flat repair, replacing one or all four, balancing, TPMS, alignment and seasonal swaps.

qa.q: Do you replace batteries?
qa.a: Yes. There's a battery and charging test, replacement, and terminal cleaning. Sample replacement is about $200-330.

qa.q: Do you do check-engine light diagnostics?
qa.a: Yes. A code scan plus inspection is a sample $70-95, and a deeper electrical or no-start diagnosis is also offered.

qa.q: Do you do A/C repair?
qa.a: Yes: A/C recharge, leak check, cabin air filter, heater and blower problems, and compressor work.

qa.q: Do you do transmission work?
qa.a: Yes: diagnosis, fluid and filter service, clutch replacement, leak repair, and rebuild or replace. These are priced by quote.

qa.q: Do you do suspension and steering?
qa.a: Yes: shocks and struts, control arms, ball joints, sway bar links, tie rods, power steering pump and steering rack.

qa.q: Do you do electrical repair?
qa.a: Yes: alternator, starter, battery drain test, wiring and short repair, fuses and relays, and ground cables.

qa.q: Do you do exhaust work?
qa.a: Yes: leak inspection, muffler and pipe repair, O2 sensor, catalytic converter, manifold and custom exhaust.

qa.q: Do you do headlights and taillights?
qa.a: Yes: bulb replacement, LED upgrades, headlight restoration, and taillight bulbs or housings.

qa.q: Do you do windshield and glass?
qa.a: Yes: chip repair, windshield replacement, side and back glass, and camera recalibration. These are priced by quote.

qa.q: Do you do body and paint work?
qa.a: Yes: paintless dent repair, scratches, bumper repair, panel painting, collision estimates (insurance OK) and rust repair. All are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you accept insurance for collision work?
qa.a: The app lists collision estimates as "insurance OK". Ask staff how your claim would work.

qa.q: Do you do detailing?
qa.a: Yes, as an add-on: interior, wash and wax, full detail, paint correction, ceramic coating and more. Some are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you do window tint?
qa.a: Yes: front two windows, full car (sides and back), and a windshield sun strip. The app says legal shades.

qa.q: Do you install sound systems?
qa.a: Yes: head units (CarPlay / Android Auto), speakers, and subwoofer plus amp.

qa.q: Do you do inspections?
qa.a: Yes: multi-point, pre-purchase, smog or emissions where required, state safety where required, and road-trip checks.

qa.q: Do you come to me?
qa.a: The app has a mobile service call-out for your home, work or roadside. Ask staff what's available in your area.

qa.q: Can you jump-start my car or put on my spare?
qa.a: The app lists roadside jump start and spare tire install under mobile service. They're priced by quote.

qa.q: Do you service fleets?
qa.a: Fleet and multiple-vehicle service is listed, priced by quote. Call or text to talk it over.

qa.q: How do I book a time?
qa.a: Build your quote, tap Pick a time, choose an open arrival window, then tap Request this job.

qa.q: How long are the arrival windows?
qa.a: Each window is 2 hours, like 8-10 or 10-12.

qa.q: How far ahead can I book?
qa.a: You can see and book open times up to 7 days ahead.

qa.q: What do the colors on the schedule mean?
qa.a: Open times can be tapped, Your pick is the one you chose, and Booked times are taken.

qa.q: What happens after I request a job?
qa.a: The shop reviews it and accepts it with a final quote. You can follow it in the Track tab.

qa.q: Does a request commit me to anything?
qa.a: The request asks the shop to take the job, and the shop accepts it with a final quote. Ask staff if you have questions.

qa.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
qa.a: I don't have cancellation details. Call or text (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: How do I track my car's repair?
qa.a: Open the Track tab. Every update from the shop shows up under My requests, including stages like diagnosing and almost done.

qa.q: What are the repair stages?
qa.a: Received, Diagnosing, Waiting on parts, Being worked on, Halfway, Almost done, and Ready for pickup.

qa.q: How will I know my car is ready?
qa.a: The tracker shows Ready for pickup. You can also turn on alerts to be told when it's almost done and ready.

qa.q: Can I get alerts about my car?
qa.a: Yes. Turn on in-app alerts, plus text or email options in the Alerts tab. In the demo these are simulated and nothing is actually sent.

qa.q: Will I really get texts?
qa.a: Real texts start once the shop's texting number is approved. Right now the app only simulates them.

qa.q: What is My Garage?
qa.a: It's where you save your cars, with recalls, scan history, service history and what's due next.

qa.q: Is My Garage private?
qa.a: Yes. It lives only on your phone, with no account and nothing uploaded. Clearing your browser's site data erases it.

qa.q: What maintenance reminders does My Garage show?
qa.a: Oil change, tire rotation and brake check. They're simple rules of thumb, and your owner's manual comes first.

qa.q: How do I check my tire size and stock?
qa.a: Open Tires, type your size from the sidewall (like 225/45R17), pick how many, and tap Check stock.

qa.q: Where do I find my tire size?
qa.a: It's printed on the side of every tire, like P225/45R17 94V. It's also on the sticker inside the driver's door jamb.

qa.q: What do the numbers in a tire size mean?
qa.a: 225 is the width in millimeters, 45 is the sidewall height as a percent of the width, and R17 fits a 17-inch wheel.

qa.q: What formats of tire size work?
Can I hold a set of tires?
qa.a: Yes. If your size is in stock you can hold a set and it's added to your quote. Stock shown is sample inventory in the demo.

qa.q: What if my tire size is out of stock?
qa.a: The app says it isn't in stock and shows the shop can order it. The usual wait shown is a sample 2-3 business days.

qa.q: Don't know my tire size?
qa.a: Pick your car and the app can show your factory tire size. Double-check the door sticker.

qa.q: What does "Scan my car" do?
qa.a: It reads your check-engine trouble codes, explains them in plain words and can add the likely fix to your quote.

qa.q: Do I need a special adapter to scan?
qa.a: You need a Bluetooth LE (BLE) ELM327 adapter plugged in under the dash. Or type a code from any scanner or parts store instead.

qa.q: Which scan adapters work?
qa.a: Veepeak OBDCheck BLE+, Vgate iCar Pro BLE 4.0, and OBDLink CX. Get a BLE or Bluetooth 4.0 model.

qa.q: Which browser works for Bluetooth scanning?
qa.a: Chrome on Android or a computer, or the Bluefy browser on iPhone. Safari on iPhone can't use Bluetooth.

qa.q: Can I scan without an adapter?
qa.a: You can type a code like P0420 to look it up, or try the demo scan with sample data.

qa.q: Will the scanner clear my codes?
qa.a: No. It's read-only and never clears codes.

qa.q: Is a code the same as a diagnosis?
qa.a: No. Codes point to a system, not a guaranteed part. The mechanic makes the final diagnosis.

qa.q: Can the app scan my Tesla?
qa.a: Teslas don't use the standard OBD-II port for owner scans, so a reader won't show useful codes. Write down alerts from Controls > Service and tell the shop. The app never asks for your Tesla password.

qa.q: Does the app show safety recalls?
qa.a: Yes. Once you pick year, make and model, it shows NHTSA recalls and common owner complaints. Recall repairs are free at a dealer.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Use Pay with QR: scan the code with your phone camera, pick how to pay, and your receipt is texted to you. In the demo, no real payment is processed.

qa.q: What payment methods do you accept?
qa.a: The pay screen lists Apple Pay, Google Pay, card (tap or chip), Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal and pay over time (Affirm / Klarna). Confirm with staff.

qa.q: Can I pay over time?
qa.a: The pay screen lists Affirm / Klarna as an option. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: Can I order or pay from a table?
qa.a: This is an auto shop app, so there's no table ordering. For payment, use Pay with QR at the counter or bay.

qa.q: Is there a menu?
qa.a: No. This app lists services instead. Tap Services to see them.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: No, the app has no kids mode.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: English and Spanish. Use the EN / ES switch at the top.

qa.q: Can I install the app on my phone?
qa.a: The app runs in your browser. I don't have install steps, so ask staff if you want it on your home screen.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't see a wallet card in this app.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your garage and requests stay on your phone, and the exact shop address is shared only after booking. The demo sends nothing anywhere.

qa.q: Do you show before and after photos?
qa.a: Yes, there's a Drag the slider section. In the demo it uses sample art, with the shop's real photos to come.

qa.q: Can I talk to a person?
qa.a: Yes. Tap Call / text on the home screen or use (555) 010-0000.

qa.q: I have a question the app can't answer. What do I do?
qa.a: Ask staff or call or text (555) 010-0000.
